resources.string: Shows while Pathline is actively recording your route.
Important notices when recording is paused or interrupted.
Pathline stopped recording when you removed it from Recents. It resumes automatically the next time you open the app.
Pathline was stopped and couldn\'t resume recording on its own. Tap Resume to start recording again, or open the app.
No activity recorded for this day
Your timeline isn\'t being updated. Tap to turn recording on.
No recorded locations to export for this activity
Could not export this activity. Please try again.
No altitude recorded for this activity
No speed recorded for this activity
Confirm this activity to add notes and tags.
Couldn\'t confirm this activity. Reopen it from the timeline and try again.
No route recorded for this activity
Saved by apps you\'ve connected. View only.
Places you visit will appear here once detected.

Radius: %1$d m · tap the map to set the center
Stop adjusting the center and radius from new visits.
Pathline needs a current location or at least one saved timeline location to search nearby places.
Merge %1$s into a saved place. Nearest places appear first.
Places whose coordinates need review are excluded from distance comparisons.
Choose the place to keep. Its name, address, and location will stay the same.
Merge “%1$s” into “%2$s”? All visits will move to the selected place. Tags will be combined, and notes and memories will be appended. The other place will be removed.
This uses saved place data. Unsaved edits on this page will be discarded.
Could not merge these places. They may have changed. Close this dialog and try again.
Could not ignore this pair. Try again.
Not enough samples to split — reclassify the whole item.
Use motion sensors and geofencing to reduce battery consumption.
Save battery while device is idle
Reduce recording frequency during Doze to save battery.
Pause recording when app is closed
Turn off to keep recording after closing Pathline (i.e, remove from Recents).
Inspect and share internal data and session logs.
Sends crash and performance diagnostics to Firebase (Google) to help fix problems. Your location data is never included.
Pathline keeps a private, on-device timeline of the places you visit and the trips between them — no account, and your location never leaves your phone.
Pathline records where you go and how you get there. It needs a few permissions to work correctly.
Shows a status notice while recording is active.
Records where you go so Pathline can build your timeline.
Detects when you\'re moving and how you travel, so recording stays light on the battery.
To build a complete timeline, location access needs to be set to \"Allow all the time\" so Pathline keeps recording when the app is closed. Android asks for this separately on the next screen.

Your device might prevent Pathline from running in the background or starting automatically, which can interrupt location recording. To help keep your timeline complete, you can allow Pathline to auto-start (sometimes called auto-launch or background startup) in your device settings.
Precise location is turned off. Pathline needs precise location to detect visits and trips — turn it on for Pathline in app settings.
Android is no longer showing the permission dialog. Grant the permission for Pathline in app settings instead.
Back up your full timeline and places to a folder you choose (Google Drive, Dropbox, local storage). Only the latest week is re-uploaded each time.
One-time database dump writes a complete standalone copy to a folder you pick.
Open-format weekly .gpx tracks for other apps and maps. Lat/lon/elevation/time only — not a backup, and it can\'t be restored.
GPX files are always stored unencrypted.
Pick a folder to keep a GPX copy updated automatically as you record.
One-time export writes weekly .gpx files to a folder you pick.
Export all recorded dates, or choose a date range.
Protect the backup with a password you remember, or a passkey (synced by your password manager — nothing to remember, works on your other devices).
Choose how to protect this one-time dump.
Subfolder (leave empty to use the folder itself)
This location already contains Pathline backup files. They will be moved into a new archive subfolder before the new backup starts.
This password protects the backup. On this device it\'s stored securely in the Android Keystore; keep a copy somewhere safe to restore on another device.
Backup folder is no longer accessible — reconnect it
Backup key unavailable — re-enter your password/passkey
No backup found in that folder
Backup is missing its passkey salt

Pathline needs your backup password or passkey before scheduled backups can continue.

Choose this only if the original Google baseline was already WGS‑84. The numbers will be kept exactly as stored.
Choose this only if you know the current saved center is already WGS‑84. The numbers will be kept exactly as stored.

Choose this only if the saved center was a pure point selected on the affected old Google map. Do not choose it for an automatically drifting or mixed center. Pathline will normalize that point with the frozen July 2026 map profile.
